name: Deathly Pall
body:
School abjuration; Level death mage 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level

DESCRIPTION

You call upon the immunities of the already dead to grant yourself some of their resilience. You gain cold resistance 5, a +2 enhancement bonus to your Strength, and 1d6 temporary hit points, +1 per 2 caster levels (maximum +5). Your skin becomes pale and your eyes turn dark, giving you a +5 bonus to disguise checks to appear to be dead or undead.
